descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Twombly's Red Sentinel' Red Sentinel Columnar Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 In the late 1970’s, Ken Twombly of Twombly’s Nursery in CT, found a compact growth shaped mutation on a red bloodgood-type of a Japanese maple at a church in eastern Connecticut. When this broom-like mutation was propagated it had a very unusual form. The name of ‘Twombly’s Red Sentinel’ which Ken chose describes this Japanese maple perfectly. These grafted trees remain tall and upright, yet fairly narrow, making it a great mid-sized flag-pole-like tree of color for small spaces. ‘Twombly’s Red Sentinel’ leafs out in the early spring as a bright red, maturing to a deeper maroon by summer. In autumn, the electric red fall color will grab your attention in the landscape. It will reach 8-10 ft in height by 3 ft wide in 15 years. Because of this shape, Ken recommends using this maple as a high class hedge. 1 gallon

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Twombly's Red Sentinel' 红叶柱形日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 20 世纪 70 年代末，康涅狄格州 Twombly's Nursery 的 Ken Twombly 在康州东部一座教堂里的一株红叶 Bloodgood 类型日本枫上发现了一个生长紧凑、形态异常的芽变。 将这一 broom-like（扫帚状）变异繁殖后，得到了一种极不寻常的树形。 Ken 为其命名为 'Twombly's Red Sentinel'，这个名字非常贴切地描述了该日本枫。 嫁接后的植株保持高耸直立，但相当狭窄，因此非常适合作为小空间中的中型彩叶“旗杆状”树种。
